svg.title: Version 1 step 1: simulated charging curves
svg.desc: Under an assumed 3.3 volt Thevenin source with 1 kilohm resistance, the 4700 microfarad capacitor reaches 3 volts in 11.6 seconds. The 0.47 farad supercapacitor reaches it in 19.4 minutes. These are model results, not hardware measurements.
svg.text: Charging time depends strongly on storage capacitance
LTspice 26.0.1 · assumed V_EH = 3.3 V open circuit, R_SOURCE = 1 kΩ, U1 disabled; no capacitor leakage
Dashed line: 3.0 V minimum regulator start voltage. Different horizontal time scales; curves are analytic and checked against LTspice crossing times.
